subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select 'No substitution required'.**

If I see a snake, I __tried to catch__ it.
solution:
The correct answer is **'will try to catch'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Replace** 'tried'** with** 'will try' **to make the sentence correct.
 
• Will and shall are **modal** **verbs**.
 
• They are used with the** base form of the main verb**.
 
• Rule
